Reel 05Questions

Answered plainly.

01 What does it cost?

Movie Space is ₹1,500 for up to 5 guests and ₹1,700 for 6 or 7. Celebration & Date Night is ₹1,500 plus the decoration you choose. Karaoke is ₹150 per person for 30 minutes, with a minimum of 3. Cake, flowers and a photoshoot are optional extras, and taxes and applicable charges are additional.

02 Is the room really private?

Yes. For the length of your session the room is reserved for your group only — no shared seating and no other bookings running alongside yours.

03 How many people can come?

Up to 7 can book online. Karaoke needs at least 3 — for fewer, call us and we'll see what we can do. Date Night is set up for two.

04 Can we bring our own cake, food or decor?

Tell us what you're planning when you pre-book and we'll confirm what's allowed. We also offer cake, food and decor as add-ons if you'd rather we set it up.

05 Where are you, and when are you open?

We're in Jabalpur and opening soon. Pre-book now and we'll share the exact address and your confirmed slot when we call you.

06 When and how do I pay?

By UPI. When you finish a booking you can pay straight away — we show you a QR code and a pay link with the amount filled in — or choose to pay after we call. Either way we confirm the slot with you, and if we can't give it to you, you get a full refund. We never ask for card details.
